author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ireland achieved a historic 2-0 T20I series triumph over reigning world champions India, with debutant Jai Moondra emerging as the unlikely hero. The software engineer from Rajasthan claimed crucial wickets, including Sanju Samson and Shreyas Iyer, to seal a dramatic one-run victory. Moondra, named Player of the Match and Series, expressed disbelief at the monumental achievement.
title: 'Still trying to process it': Rajasthan-born Moondra revels in Ireland's India triumph

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Italy's competition watchdog has launched an investigation into Microsoft over claims it automatically upgraded subscribers to pricier Microsoft 365 plans with new AI features like Copilot and Designer. The authority is concerned customers weren't clearly informed about the AI integration and the resulting price hike, potentially leading to an unfair commercial practice and restricted consumer choice.
title: Microsoft under Italy regulator’s scanner over Copilot, designer integration

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Fuel crunch in Russia: Putin admits 'shortage' as Ukraine drone attacks batter energy sites

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Harshavardhan GB became India's 97th Grandmaster, ending a six-year wait since earning his IM title in 2020. Nicknamed "legend" by his chess peers for his creative brilliance, the 22-year-old overcame repeated near-misses, financial struggles and travel hardships. Backed by his family and coaches, Harshavardhan's emotional breakthrough has now set him on the path towards becoming a super Grandmaster.
title: Making of India's 97th GM Harshavardhan: A 'legend' among friends, now his parents' pride

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: Watch: Flash floods ravage Arunachal, Assam, submerge roads, trigger landslide

author: LACHIT ROY
description: The Blue Jays entered 2026 expecting another October run after coming within reach of a championship against the Los Angeles Dodgers. Instead, Toronto has spent most of the season below .500, turning a roster built to contend into one of the deadline's most closely watched evaluations. At 39-44, the club remains within striking distance of an American League Wild Card berth because of a tightly packed playoff race. Yet the same standings that keep Toronto alive also force the front office to confront a difficult possibility.
title: MLB trade rumors: Blue Jays could part ways with $110 million star by trade deadline

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ireland secured a historic 2-0 T20I series win over India, marking a tough start for captain Shreyas Iyer. India faltered in their chase of 155, falling short by one run despite a late surge. Iyer acknowledged Ireland's superior understanding of the conditions, admitting India's batting unit struggled to adapt. The defeat also ended India's impressive 16-series winning streak.
title: 'They outplayed us': Shreyas Iyer joins Pant in unwanted club after Ireland shock

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: China has expanded its technology and national security restrictions by adding 20 Japanese entities, including a defense studies institute, to its export control list. This move, barring dual-use item exports, follows similar actions against 10 US firms last week. Beijing states the decision aims to protect national security and uphold non-proliferation commitments amidst rising geopolitical tensions.
title: China blacklists 20 Japanese entities after imposing export curbs on 10 US firms

author: TNN
description: Delhi sweltered under extreme heat stress, with 'feels like' temperatures soaring past 50 degrees Celsius and night temperatures hitting a two-year high for June. A heatwave intensified the oppressive conditions, exacerbated by high humidity. This prolonged exposure poses significant health risks, with monsoon rains still delayed, offering little immediate relief to the capital's residents.
title: 24-hour heat stress: Day ‘feel’ 50°C, night warmest in 2 years in Delhi

author: RAHUL SINGH
description: A tragic accident on the Delhi-Dehradun expressway claimed four lives from a Haryana family. Their car, reportedly being reversed after a missed exit, was violently struck from behind by a speeding SUV. The collision, captured on CCTV, was so forceful that the victims' vehicle was dragged and flipped, leaving three others critically injured. Authorities are investigating the incident.
title: SUV hits car reversing on Delhi-Dehradun expressway; 4 of Haryana family dead

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Watch: Massive black smoke billows from Russian oil refinery after Ukrainian drone strike, 1 dead

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Canada secured a historic 1-0 victory over South Africa with a stunning 92nd-minute volley from Stephen Eustaquio at SoFi Stadium. This marks Canada's first-ever knockout stage win in World Cup history. Despite South Africa's strong defense, Eustaquio's late heroics propelled Canada into the Round of 16, where they will face either the Netherlands or Morocco. The win was a significant moment for the nation's football program.
title: FIFA WC: Stephen Eustaquio's late stunner sends Canada into historic last 16

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: England captain Ben Stokes has revealed the profound emotional toll of the Ashes defeat as the primary reason for his international retirement.  He confessed to his wife that he felt "no more fight" left to overcome the disappointment.  Stokes cited overwhelming emotional, physical, and mental exhaustion, accumulated over years of demanding cricket, as the driving force behind his decision to step away from the game he loves.
title: 'I don't have any more fight left in me': Ben Stokes reveals reason behind shock retirement

author: POULAMI ROY
description: Bengal's education department is exploring an Odisha-like model for midday meals, offering schools extra funds to purchase eggs independently, aiming to resolve the controversy surrounding Iskcon's vegetarian-only menu. This move follows criticism that the government is pushing an agenda by excluding eggs, a staple in many children's diets. Officials are set to discuss the new modalities soon, as the debate over nutrition and cultural preferences intensifies.
title: West Bengal eyes Odisha model to keep eggs on midday meal menu despite Iskcon takeover

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A haunting social media message has surfaced in connection with a horrific triple homicide in Rome, where a father, mother, and their young daughter were discovered lifeless. The primary suspect, 43-year-old Shahadat Hossain from Bangladesh, is the focus of an extensive manhunt by the police. His ominous post, stating, 'A man does not die alone,' is now pivotal to the ongoing investigation.
title: ‘A man does not die alone’: Chilling messages left by Bangladeshi man before killing family

author: SHISHIR ARYA
description: A Nagpur-based company's CEO and seven others face US sanctions for allegedly supplying military explosives to Sudan, fueling the ongoing civil war. The US Treasury claims 200 bomb shipments were sent, though the company denies this, stating they exported only mining-grade ammonium nitrate. The company plans to appeal the ban, asserting their exports are for commercial use in over 20 countries.
title: ‘Bombs sent to Sudan’: US treasury department blacklists Nagpur company

author: TNN
description: Investigators are zeroing in on Ram Shankar Yadav and Anukalp Mishra as potential masterminds in the Ram Temple donation embezzlement case. Their close ties to senior trust officials and access to the donation system are under scrutiny. Police are examining how Yadav allegedly facilitated his nephew's inclusion and Mishra influenced his brother-in-law's deployment, suggesting a coordinated effort to divert funds.
title: Masterminds? Ram temple donation embezzlement probe focuses on Tinnu Yadav, Anukalp

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: Authorities are investigating Ram Temple donation theft accused Anukalp Mishra for amassing assets potentially disproportionate to his income. Investigators are scrutinizing a newly built farmhouse, a Rs 65 lakh Ayodhya house, and an attempted SUV purchase. Property documents recovered from his residence are under examination, alongside bank records and financial transactions, to determine the source of funds for these acquisitions and other recent purchases.
title: Farmhouse, SUV, bike — and Rs 15K salary: Ram temple donation theft accused’s assets under scanner

author: SUNNY BASKI
description: In Hyderabad, a staggering number of homebuyers find themselves in a predicament, as delays have affected nearly 63,000 housing units, some postponed by over a year. This alarming situation arises from supply chain issues linked to ongoing conflicts in the Middle East, alongside increasing costs and a shortage of labor
title: Bought 4 years ago, still waiting: The supply chain shock behind Hyderabad’s 63,000 delayed homes

author: TNN
title: Medical device makers set for quicker clearances

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Daenerys Targaryen, the iconic Mother of Dragons from 'Game of Thrones', is making waves in 'House of the Dragon' lore. A recent clip features Daemon Targaryen recounting a prophetic vision at Harrenhal, describing a silver-haired girl with dragons, strongly hinting at Daenerys. This builds on a previous vision at a weirwood tree, further linking the prequel's events to the future of Westeros and Game of Thrones.
title: House of the Dragon S3: Daemon and Rhaenyra scene with Daenerys reference goes viral

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Tilak Varma's resilient half-century was a lone bright spot for India in their narrow one-run loss to Ireland, despite becoming one of the slowest Indian fifties in T20Is.  Walking in during a top-order collapse, Varma battled tough conditions to reach his milestone.  Ultimately, Ireland secured a historic series win, ending India's impressive streak.
title: Tilak Varma enters unwanted record books after slowest-ever T20I fifty against Ireland

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The loss meant India failed to qualify for the semi-finals despite posting 170 for four after being asked to bat.
title: 'Didn't play well against good teams': Harmanpreet minces no words after WC exit

author: RAM SUNDARAM
description: Tamil Nadu police have launched 'Spectrum' in the south zone to classify and track sexual offenders based on risk. This project categorizes around 15,000 individuals into eight color-coded groups, from high-risk 'Red' for gang rape accused to 'Silver' for juveniles. The initiative aims for targeted monitoring, especially of repeat offenders and cybercriminals, utilizing biometrics and social media surveillance to enhance public safety.
title: Colour-coded crime: Tamil Nadu cops rank 15k sex offenders by risk
